problem.title: How to copy a folder into an existing folder using python
problem.description: I am new to python, and am currently trying to copy a folder 'foo' (potentially with some files/folders inside) into another existing folder 'bar'. By copying 'foo' into 'bar' I do not wish to have the original contents in 'bar' to be removed, and the only changes in 'bar' is a new subfolder 'foo' being added.
